_about: Bible Gateway, fetched 29 Sep 2026 (v10.40.0): the printed text of every passage Terrain quotes, KJV and Reina-Valera Antigua 1909 (RVA), verse numbers, footnotes and headings left out, verses of a range joined by one space. tests/v40-accuracy.test.js holds every Scripture string in index.html, and every quoted verse in the Idea Library source (tools/ideas-src), to these (Numbers 6:24, Psalm 46:1 and Proverbs 17:22 fetched for the library in the v10.40.0 review pass). Public domain texts.

Then I told them of the hand of my God which was good upon me; as also the king's words that he had spoken unto me. And they said, Let us rise up and build. So they strengthened their hands for this good work.

RVA.heading: Nehemías 2:17-18

KJV.text: And the saying pleased the whole multitude: and they chose Stephen, a man full of faith and of the Holy Ghost, and Philip, and Prochorus, and Nicanor, and Timon, and Parmenas, and Nicolas a proselyte of Antioch:

RVA.heading: Hechos 6:5
RVA.text: Y plugo el parecer á toda la multitud; y eligieron á Esteban, varón lleno de fe y de Espíritu Santo, y á Felipe, y á Prócoro, y á Nicanor, y á Timón, y á Parmenas, y á Nicolás, prosélito de Antioquía:

KJV.heading: Acts 15:28
KJV.text: For it seemed good to the Holy Ghost, and to us, to lay upon you no greater burden than these necessary things;

RVA.heading: Hechos 15:28
RVA.text: Que ha parecido bien al Espíritu Santo, y á nosotros, no imponeros ninguna carga más que estas cosas necesarias:

KJV.heading: Acts 2:42
KJV.text: And they continued stedfastly in the apostles' doctrine and fellowship, and in breaking of bread, and in prayers.

RVA.heading: Hechos 2:42
RVA.text: Y perseveraban en la doctrina de los apóstoles, y en la comunión, y en el partimiento del pan, y en las oraciones.

KJV.heading: 1 Peter 2:2
KJV.text: As newborn babes, desire the sincere milk of the word, that ye may grow thereby:

RVA.heading: 1 Pedro 2:2
RVA.text: Desead, como niños recién nacidos, la leche espiritual, sin engaño, para que por ella crezcáis en salud:
